original.target_description: Shah et al. (2012), Low-wealth subjects, that are given fewer chances to win in repeated ’Wheel Science of Fortune’ type word puzzle games, perform worse in a subsequent attention task (Dots-Mixed task) than do high-wealth individuals (a comparison of the mean performance on the Dots-Mixed task between the ’poor treatment’ and the ’rich treatment’; ANOVA test, F (1, 54) = 4.16 and p = 0.046, p. 683).
